3. In strict mode, this causes the function to return early
4. In non-strict mode, it continues to `av.split('=',2)`
5. `av_parts[0]` will be empty string, `av_parts[1]` will be undefined
6. `av_key` becomes empty string after trim().toLowerCase()
7. The switch statement will hit the default case and add the empty string to extensions
